context:
This is a React Router v7 + Drizzle ORM + SQLite (better-sqlite3) full-stack app.

Key folders:
- app/routes/ — file-based routes (React Router v7); loaders and actions co-located
- app/services/ — business logic, one file per domain (e.g. courseService.ts)
- app/db/ — schema.ts (Drizzle table definitions) and index.ts (db connection)
- app/lib/ — shared utilities and server-side helpers
- app/components/ — shared UI components
- drizzle/ — SQL migration files generated by drizzle-kit
- scripts/ — one-off scripts (seed.ts, etc.)
- issues/ — open issue files (AFK = agent-ready, HITL = needs human review)

Conventions:
- Services have co-located .test.ts files using vitest
- DB access goes through app/db/index.ts
- Use Zod for validation (app/lib/validation.ts)
- pnpm is the package manager
